name: btcusd-m15-train-test
description: Train and test a BTCUSD M15 model using data BTCUSDm_M1_202107030000_202609060000.csv, and produce a full report.

members.name: data-engineer
members.role: Data pipeline engineer — owns requirements, M1→M15 resampling, override config, and running the pipeline stages

members.name: model-engineer
members.role: Model training engineer — owns implementation of the BTCUSD M15 training run + artifacts + metrics

members.name: reviewer
members.role: QA/verification engineer — runs verification gates and reviews the training against acceptance criteria

members.name: reporter
members.role: Reporting engineer — compiles the full report and registers the BTCUSD model

tasks.subject: Requirements: BTCUSD M15 training spec
tasks.description: Define concrete acceptance criteria for training and testing a BTCUSD M15 model using the xauusd-liquidity-sweep pipeline as base. Specify: data source (BTCUSDm_M1_202107030000_202609060000.csv, M1 → resampled to M15), overriding symbol=BTCUSD following the EURUSD cross-asset precedent, the config/stage list (audit → events → dataset → train), expected artifacts (model.pkl, calibrator.pkl, feature_schema under pipeline_v2/artifacts/models/btcusd/), required metrics (PR-AUC primary on test + walk-forward, plus ROC-AUC/Brier/accuracy where produced), and full-report deliverable contents. No look-ahead must be preserved (causal resampling, closed-HTF merge, causal labeling).
tasks.objective: Produce a written acceptance contract for the BTCUSD M15 training run.
acceptance: Spec states exact data path, resampling M1→M15 method, and override config path
Lists the 4 pipeline stages to run in order with their CLI entry points
Lists required output artifacts and their exact relative paths
Specifies primary metric (PR-AUC) on test and walk-forward, plus secondary metrics
Defines the full-report deliverable contents
Confirms no-look-ahead constraints (causal resample, closed HTF, causal label)

tasks.subject: Implement: BTCUSD M15 training run
tasks.description: Implement the BTCUSD M15 training run following the requirements spec and the established EURUSD cross-asset precedent in the xauusd-liquidity-sweep pipeline. Create trading_live/research/xauusd-liquidity-sweep/configs/btcusd_override.yaml (symbol=BTCUSD, input = the M1 CSV resampled to M15, output parquet). Set up M1→M15 resampling (causal; preserve raw M1). Run the four CLI stages in order: xauusd-audit, xauusd-events, xauusd-dataset, xauusd-train using the override config. Use the existing .venv in the pipeline dir. Ensure artifacts land under pipeline_v2/artifacts/models/btcusd/ (model.pkl, calibrator.pkl, feature_schema). Produce test and walk-forward metrics (PR-AUC primary). Do NOT touch XAUUSD or EURUSD artifacts/data — data isolation is mandatory.
tasks.objective: Run the complete BTCUSD M15 train pipeline end-to-end and produce artifacts + metrics.
acceptance: btcusd_override.yaml created under trading_live/research/xauusd-liquidity-sweep/configs/ with symbol=BTCUSD and correct M1→M15 input/output paths
M1→M15 resampling applied so the pipeline runs on M15 base candles (raw M1 preserved)
All 4 pipeline stages (audit, events, dataset, train) ran successfully on BTCUSD via the override config
Artifacts exist under pipeline_v2/artifacts/models/btcusd/: model.pkl, calibrator.pkl, feature_schema
Test metrics generated: PR-AUC (primary) + walk-forward PR-AUC + secondary metrics where pipeline produces them
No XAUUSD/EURUSD artifacts were overwritten or touched (data isolation per project rule)
verify: git status --porcelain trading_live/research/xauusd-liquidity-sweep/artifacts/ | grep -q '' || echo 'XAUUSD/EURUSD artifacts untouched'

tasks.subject: Verify: BTCUSD M15 training run artifacts + metrics
tasks.description: Run the required verification commands for the BTCUSD M15 training run and confirm artifacts, metrics, and data isolation. Verify model.pkl/calibrator.pkl/feature_schema exist under pipeline_v2/artifacts/models/btcusd/, btcusd_override.yaml exists, metrics reports (test PR-AUC + walk-forward PR-AUC) are produced, no no-look-ahead violations, CI gate passes if pipeline code changed, and that no XAUUSD/EURUSD artifacts or raw data were modified.
tasks.objective: Verify the BTCUSD M15 training run against the acceptance criteria.
acceptance: All verify commands pass
model.pkl + calibrator.pkl + feature_schema present under pipeline_v2/artifacts/models/btcusd/
Test PR-AUC and walk-forward PR-AUC values are produced and reported
No no-look-ahead violations in the BTCUSD data path (causal resample/HTF/label)
CI gate / relevant unit + no_lookahead tests pass for changed pipeline code (if any)
XAUUSD and EURUSD artifacts untouched

tasks.subject: Review (round 1): BTCUSD M15 training run
tasks.description: Review the BTCUSD M15 training run (task t2 implementation) against its acceptance criteria. Confirm the model/calibrator/feature_schema artifacts exist under pipeline_v2/artifacts/models/btcusd/, the override config is correct, the test and walk-forward PR-AUC metrics are produced and plausible for a liquidity-sweep model, no-look-ahead was preserved, and XAUUSD/EURUSD data isolation held. Verdict must be pass, needs_revision, or reject with structured findings.
tasks.objective: Pass or reject the BTCUSD M15 training implementation with structured findings.
acceptance: Verdict is pass only if the implementation genuinely meets the acceptance criteria (artifacts present, metrics produced, no isolation breach)
Review reports the actual test PR-AUC / walk-forward PR-AUC values and their plausibility
Any gap is reported as a structured finding (id, severity, problem, requiredFix)

tasks.subject: Integrate: full BTCUSD M15 report + model registry
tasks.description: Compile the full BTCUSD M15 training report. Write a complete markdown report in the pipeline reports dir (trading_live/research/xauusd-liquidity-sweep/pipeline_v2/reports/metrics/btcusd_report.md or similar) covering data overview, M1→M15 resampling, events/dataset stats, model + calibration, test metrics (PR-AUC primary), walk-forward results, score-bucket performance, costs, and limitations. Register the BTCUSD model in configs/models/index.yaml with a fresh model_id (e.g. btcusd_v2_h16_<date>, symbol_origin BTCUSD, paths under btcusd/) without touching XAUUSD/EURUSD entries.
tasks.objective: Produce the full BTCUSD M15 report and register the model in the registry.
acceptance: Full report written covering: data overview, resampling, events/dataset, model + calibration, test metrics (PR-AUC primary), walk-forward results, score-bucket performance, costs, and any gaps/limitations
BTCUSD model registered in configs/models/index.yaml (model_id btcusd_v2_h16_*, symbol_origin BTCUSD, paths under btcusd/)
Report references concrete metric values from the produced artifacts
XAUUSD/EURUSD registry entries and artifacts left untouched
